svg.title: AC migration-group socioeconomic profile, Person-weighted pool, 1970-2010
svg.text: Migration proxy varies by census; observations are weighted by person, not by year
Bars are percentages within migration group and panel; legend sizes use census person weights.
Income: no income plus national weighted quintiles among positive-income adults (1980 uses main-job income).
1970: Guanabara -> RJ; Fernando de Noronha -> PE; MT and GO retain historical boundaries.
